scope: Independent raw clean final-v4 eleven-run review; original failures from previous candidates remain preserved
method: Own parsers over original raw serial/evidence JSON, tracer entry/exit, independent sysfs snapshots, PCAP/USBMON and probe assertions. No runner verify imported or called.

facts.strict_serial_payload_scope: No separate raw host payload artifact; expected SHA compared to runner observation and strict guest exact-content assertions.

limitations: No in-kernel active-window, arbitrary hardware, performance benchmark or wholePhase2 acceptance claim.
Syscall-entry pause precedes kernel handler. Deliberate release fault is guest-root IF0 external unbind; tracer does not inspect ioctl argument memory.
USBMON -32/actual1/opaque byte is kernel-reported QEMU/UHCI behavior and does not prove a physical error transferred a byte.
FTDI host payload has no separate raw artifact; independent expected SHA is compared to original host observation and strict guest content assertions.
Run-start/sequence clean facts are distinct from later review-time documentation dirtiness.
No repository writes, builds/Cargo, QEMU, USB, ptrace, module or host-network operations performed.
